'''Ganuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Evocii]] foreman who lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="Chemical Agent" />

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he suspected that the Empire was creating poisonous chemicals that would [[Death/Legends|kill]] specific sentient species. After spreading the word, he asked a Republic-allied individual to infiltrate [[Pharmalux Technologies]] and scan their mainframe.<ref name="Chemical Agent" /> Upon discovering that the Empire planned to kill all Evocii on Nar Shaddaa, he asked the Republic-allied individual to assault the [[Pharmalux Waste Processing facility]] and prevent [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vergost]] from unleashing the chemicals that would kill millions.<ref name="Extermination" />
